Felicia is an antagonist of Taimanin Kurenai. At first, she is introduced as a supporting character until, the truth is revealed.

She is a half-vampire but has given into her demonic side and is insane, unlike her older sister Kurenai. Felicia works for her father Edwin Black and Nomad, sometimes undercover. Her birthname is, Shinganji Fumika as desired by her mother, Kaede.

Hmmm. Humans are so stupid, crying just from that little.
Felicia



Personality
Felicia is upfront, acting childish, but also insane and murderous. With little to no empathy, Felicia likes to play games with others' lives on the line, she often seeks entertainment in fights. Unlike her slightly older sister, Felicia enjoys her demonic side and seems to dislike, that even a small part of her could be considered human. Having a low opinion of humans in general and how easy they break mentally. While she is able to show kindness that is genuine and can independently defend others, risking her out life, she is often too unstable and dangerous to be around.

She has no issue using sex or self humiliation, while waiting for her time to strike, and is able to "act" like a submissive girl. Being very lewd, confident and open to sexual things, she is only jealous of her sister having a larger bust. Regardless of her childish "acting", she is very experienced and almost nothing is shocking or embarrassing to her and she has killed many that thought they had the upper hand in her bloodlust.

Felicia remains highly unpredictable and dangerous to friends and foes alike, as she was deeply loyal to her father and would kill even her own sister for him, but is also rather independent and free spirited. Her high degree of insanity can be seen when she killed her own mother so she would not make more sibling, that Edwin Black would share his attention with in the original timeline. Otherwise, she often kills allies and people that bore her.

Felicia often does not fight fair, and attacks from the shadows with sneak attack first and views fights more as games, for her own entertainment. She also does not care if she is harmed herself in a fight and needs to be either knocked out or pulled back by her father in such cases.

Pretending to be loyal to the House of Greed and Tendo Kazuma, she killed him like a fly when he was no longer needed. The Action Taimanin version of her is much softer, yet still dangerous.

The RPGX version also is loyal to Teutates instead of Black, as she has been brainwashed since her birth.

Felicia typically wears a simple white dress, with cuffs and collars

History
Background
Felicia 10
Felicia is the result of an breeding experiment of Edwin Black, in which the vampire would try to conceive a child. This experiment was performed in the Canon Universe and TABA Timeline long before Taimanin Asagi, meanwhile in Taimanin RPG, this encounter was consensual affaire and her planned name was Fumika Shinganji.

Noble demons like vampires, require powerful partners to conceive, and the Shinganji clan members were genetically able to cross-breed very easily. Shinganji Kaede, the daughter of the clan chief, was kidnapped by Black and impregnated by him. The first daughter born was Shinganji Kurenai, around the year 2048. The clan chief Shinganji Gen-an arrived to save his daughter but was too injured and was only able to save baby Kurenai, leaving his daughter behind. The experiment continued and Felicia was the second daughter born, not long after in either the same year or around 2049.

Even after the birth of the escaped Kurenai and now Felicia, other children were born but the number is unknown. Even as a half-vampire crossbreed, she was much stronger than any other children and gave into her demonic side for her father's approval or out of legitimate insanity. Felicia never showed Taimanin-like abilities, and it is possible that she has turned fully into a demon at that point. Growing up in the Dark World, with little to no parental moral guide and inherent insanity, grew into a psychotic killer. In her late teens, for attention, she murderd her other siblings and own mother Kaede, as Edwin Black considered two daughters as "enough". She became a member of Nomad, that only would listen to Black directly.

Visual Novels
In Taimanin Kurenai, around year 2068, which played long before the TA1 prologue, Felicia was sent out to overlook her sister's training and awakening to demonic powers. Black used one of his unknowing puppets Tendo Kazuma, that was the owner of the House of Greed, to awaken Kurenai. Felicia would be tasked, to act as she was Kazuma's loyal slave, while in secret ensuring the success of Kurenai's transformation into an insane demon like herself. While giving Kurenai advice, and showing some affection, Felicia remained only interested in her sister as long as she could achieve this demonic state.

Felicia 2
Felicia 3
Felicia would cure Kurenai's Taimanin partner, Makishima Ayame that was also captured, of a mental control curse. Leading to an opportunity for Kurenai, to free herself and awaken. Felicia, killing the no longer needed Kazuma, introduced herself as her sister together with her father Edwin Black, that also appeared.

However, unlike Felicia desired, Kurenai did not give into her rage and did not become an insane demon that joined her father's side. Kurenai attacked Black, which instead dodged and just observed his two daughters fight. Felicia, that taunted her and tried to enrage one more time also mentions her own mother's death and how she had killed her. Kurenai remained resolved and recalled her training with her grandfather Gen-an, using a combination Evil Eye and Wind Art that was able to find the weakness in even immortal bodies of a vampire. Felicia, overconfident, tried to kill her sister as a failed experiment but was cut down in return by Kurenai.

Her body was taken by Edwin Black. As he states, immediate action needed to be taken otherwise she would not be able to be restored. Afterward, she is never seen again in the Canon Universe. Though kept vague, it can be assumed that she survived, even if it took years for her to be restored and is still alive in the year 2082 in TA3 as she would be in TABA.

Timeline TABA
Felicia 4
Many years after Taimanin Kurenai, Felicia returns, having been healed/cloned by Fürst. Now years older, she still looked the same, as a vampire she seems no longer to age. TABA plays between year 2082 until around 2086.

In year 2084, Felicia is part of a trap of Fürst. Using an old man disguise, Fürst requests the help of Fuuma Kotaro, to recover his daughter from a dangerous facility for money. However, when Kotaro arrives at the "Monster House" an abandoned Dragon Gate cloning research facility, he is hunted down by Felicia. At the same time he tried to explain the situation to the Taimanin, Nanase Mai, that also was tricked by Fürst, to believe the Fuuma Organization established that facility. In the end, Kotaro is able to escape thanks to Fuuma Tokiko and also saves Mai's life.

Felicia, is later seen again in another event called "Dark Lineage", in the year 2086. She tricked Lilim and Minasaki to play around in one of Nomads bases, in the hope to get Kotaro's attention. This works and the Nomad base is attacked by Fuuma Kotaro (TABA), that encounters Felicia again and is able to take care of the "Critters" and Felicia with the help of Amamiya Shisui. As the critters have left, Felicia stays behind to fight Kotaro, frustrated that Black gives him so much attention, wanting to kill him not for Nomad or politics but only for her own grudge. In a battle between, Shisui Felicia is pushed back thanks to Shisui's Guardian but able to heal the damage. Edwin Black appears "giving" Kotaro the base and takes Felicia with him. However, Felicia sneaks in another attack from the shadow before leaving.

This wound, likely "killed" Amamiya Shisui or put her into a unconscious state, until the TABA Reset during the battle between Nomad and Fuuma Organization. Felicia herself, was not seen in that fight but is mentioned by Fürst as the one that sliced Shisui.

Timeline RPGX
Felicia 7
Taimanin Kurenai did not play out, when Edwin Black visited, Shinganji Sakyo in the year 2063, they formed a new version of Nomad, released from most of the evil of the past worlds, this Black was more social. Two years after, in the year 2065, Black had secretly hooked up with the sister of Sakyo, Shinganji Kaede, with Kaede giving birth that year. Two years later, in year 2067, Kurenai was living happy with her mother which was pregnant with her second daughter (Felicia, planned name Fumika). However, one night Kaede and her guard Makishima Niemon, were ambushed by Task Force G, which desired to capture Kurenai. While the commander Evie Ace, was defeated Kaede was stabbed by Teutates from behind, and her body was taken, Kurenai was able to escape thanks to Niemon, and grew up. However, Felicia and her mother ended in the hands of the Death Lord.

Her mothers body was taken to the Demon Realm, into the regions of the Death Lord, Teutates and revived. Kaede, suffered humiliation and her womb was corrupted by the magic of Teutates, even after "Felicia" or Fumika (the name her mother desired) was born, Kaede was kept alive, being killed and resurrected, with "darkness" filling her womb, which if born would corrupt her and Felicia fully. While, Kaede was close to be fully broken, she was able to escape with Felicia in her arms but was very weak. Unable to kill her daughter and hopeful she could be saved, Kaede tried to return to Black but on her way was stopped by Teutates and surrounded by a number of Wraith. Unable to escape, and learning of Teutates goals, Kaede killed herself infront of Felicia's eyes, to destroy the darkness in her womb, by cutting her carotid artery. As she was bleeding out, Felicia watched her mothers life end for the final time, not yet aware of the situation.

As TK did not take place and both Kurenai and Felicia never encountered each other. The body of Felicia's mother Shinganji Kaede, is was possibly used by Fürst to create the Frankenstein's monster-like, Vivi Blood, which body seemed to remember giving birth. Felicia, is brainwashed thinking, she was the daughter of Teutates and loyal to his goals.

Felicia RPG
In the year 2083, when Astaroth visited Yomihara and looked for strong opponents, she found the unnamed girl "Felicia" that was drawn in by the destruction. After a short fight, Felicia, was forced to retreat, realizing the overwhelming power of the Queen of the Inferno.

Felicia made multiple appearance only in the year 2086, still in the background during some Fürst events.

In year 2087, before Lady Shark made her way to recapture Oboro from a prisoner transport, after her identity as a double agent was discovered. Felicia can be seen talking to her and Wight and Lady Shark, all belonging to the Corpse Lord's army. When Lady Shark afterward is defeated, raids on multiple of the Landshark mafia's bases, connected to the Corpse Lord begin, Lady Shark returns to the hideout and, is attacked by Nomad troops trying to get rid of the Wraith influence.

Lady Shark is killed in her dual with Lina, but Felicia attacks Lina from the shadows afterward, and gets ready to strike her dead before Ingrid jumps into the fight. Both Hell Knights, prove almost to much for Felicia that regardless of danger keeps attacking without self concern, and twisted bloodlust. However, the dragon form of Ingrid and Lina almost kill her and she is saved by "True Black" Teutates, the Corpse Lord and Wraith King. Chastising, what he calls his daughter, for "risking a life that isn't hers", Felicia agrees to follow his demands, calling him father as well. Nobody in Nomad, at least up to Ingrid knows who Felicia is, something that is not the case in other timelines. Both, teleport away from the location with Ingrid worried that somebody dangerous had appeared.

Later, on Felicia is talked about by Shinganji Kurenai, Kanzaki Jyubei and Fuuma Kotaro, while in a bar in Yomihara, talking about the current expolsion of Wraith forces expulsion. These talks, are also interconnected by Flashbacks of Kichi Azusa, a cousin of Kurenai, which had been trained by Shinganji Kaede and now seeked power to revenge her death. Later on, in another event Vivi blood the Fürst experiment also arrives, and her body remembers having given birth and she feels a strange connection to Kurenai as well. All these plotlines happened around the same time, connecting Kurenai, Felicia, Kaede, Azuma and Vivi, in an ongoing narrative.

Felicia, and Anubis of the Revenant Knights are sent out to Tokyo Kingdom. Felica, killed Jiroemon of the Nisha Ninja Troops in the hope to spark a civil war, in the city. They worked with Kankuro and guarenteed him, he would take the spot of Nisha Gaiza. Felicia fought against Doryu and overpowered him, as Ryu rejected to work for Kankuro side and betray Gaiza, Felica killed him quickly. As Kankuro started to feel save in his victory with chaos breaking out in the streets, the loyal executive of Gaiza, Gaku Shonosuke appeared before them. As Kankuro began to gloat, Felica killed Kankuro as well. In truth Felica and Anubis worked with Shonosuke, which hoped to use the chaos to power his master's Ninja Art and turn him into a Demon under Teutates. As a Taimanin spy named Kagari, observed the exchanged, she was struck by an attack of Felica's group with her fate unknown. Strangly, Kagari did but was resurrected as a tiny plant creature by fully unknown means.

In year 2088, Felicia continued her minor killing spree, told not to overdo it, leaving the killing to Nisha Gaiza, which annoyed her as she wanted to kill Gaiza herself. Shonosuke reveals himself later as Wight, the true Sonosuke had been captured, and both Felicia and Wight, meet with Teutates. Felicia is praises but told to be a good girl and wait for her chance to kill Gaza a bit longer, as he needs to be fully corrupted to act as a sacrifice to create a Demon Gate.

As Nisha Gaiza made his way to Teutates, revealing he was in the know about his plans, Felicia fought against the Nisha Ninja Troops. She would first face off against Bikuni Yao, stating she was the strongest of the group. However, as the Evil Eye of Bikuni had little effect even after she wounded herself to increase its strength, Felicia became bored. She began to slash and cut Bikuni to make her "stronger" until nothing was left but Bikuni's liveless eye, Felicia wanted to take as a trophy. Afterward, as the other members of the group had already died, she attacked Gaiza from behind, promting Teutates to just observe the battle. She killed Dobashi Gonza, which jumped infront of an attack but as the Taimanin and other forces arrived to deal with the group her focus shifted. At first she wanted to fight against, Shinganji Kurenai without knowing who she was but Edwin Black (RPGX) wished to face her instead, just as Teutates had planned. In their fight Black revealed he was her father, that her mother of Shinganji Kaede, and that her name was Shinganji Fumika. However, she denied this. Overpowered by the three abilities of the Evil Eye, her abilities were sealed but a self destrucitve power within her became active. Black used his last ability, to absorb her, with her asking Teutates to save her, which ignored her plead. Within the "mind space" of Felicia and Black, he saw that her old self had been suffering under a corrupting binding influence. Knowing that he could release Felica/Fumika from this and return her mind to something more stable but would need to sacrifice himself for it, he did so. As Felica left, the dark cloud and appeared in reality again, Black's body begins to turn into a black mess and is absorbed by Teutates, as he asked Kurenai to take care of her sister Fumika. Felicia, which now is called Fumika as well, begins to break down crying asking her real father to forgive her. While Felicia, is not involved in the final fight further, she survives as Teutates is killed. However, Black remains missing with even later research only confirming that he was still alive.

Felicia herself fell unconcious after the battle, and was brought to Yomihara and is currently watched over by Ingrid and Shinganji Kurenai. Her sister Kurenai, was given an advisor role in Nomad, with all the chaos the Gaiza Massacre caused and the destruction of the Yomihara Gate during that time by Ragnarok Sinmara.

In the Festival World:

The Felicia first seen, was not the real RPGX timeline version, instead a Felicia of another world ZERO Universe, around the new year of 2082 and 2083. She was still the daughter of Edwin Black, and meets Fuuma Kotaro. Kotaro, he had been forcfully teleported to another universe, resembling the ZERO Universe, which lied over 10 years in the past. This Felicia faught against Kotaro, which had been transformed into what she assumed was a wish granting pig. Felicia was only stopped thanks to Igawa Asagi (ZERO), which was able to counter her power around the same level. Before getting serious, she got a phone call from persumingly her father, granting her wish to go to a festival with him as he had free time. Her unit gives again, the backstory of her losing to Kurenai and having been not seen since.

Timeline Action
Felicia 5
As TK did not happen and both Kurenai and Felicia never encountered each other, The exact origin story of her is somewhat unclear in this world, as Kurenai is also much younger.

Felicia has not confronted Kurenai yet, but has grown attached to Fuuma Kotaro. She likes to interrupt in his daily life, alternating between trolling him and showing affection to him. Though from a gameplay perspective, she is playable, Felicia is lore wise not part of the Task Force.

Felicia also is encountered later on as part of a group of hostage and uses a disguise to blend in. She becomes fascinated by Kotaro but thanks to her twisted view of showing affection, this is not a good thing. At some point Ingrid, gives her a present from Edwin Black, a Succubus Ring, which she Felicia hopes to use on Kotaro to kill him many times for fun in his dreams. However, after this encounter, that also involved Lilim, the bring was broken overpowered by the powers of a real Succubus. To avoid, Felicia's rage, Kotaro promises a gift next year for Christmas, something that for now calms her.

Timeline GOGO!
Taimanin Kurenai, has not played out.

Since Edwin Black retired, and became a teacher at Gosha Academy in this strange timeline. It is mentioned that he is often frustrated that his two alive daughters tend to fight each other.

Felicia, Esmeralda and Adelaide were all students of Demon Academy, before becoming exchange students.


Powers/Abilities
Felicia Ultimate
Main Weapon: Scythe (Shadow Blade or Shadow Scythe)

Magic Scythe: "Shadow Blade" Her main weapon has the added effect that people hit by it decay and can be summoned. Aside from summoning it, she can also telekinetically recall it to her grasp if she throws it or is somehow disarmed.
Ancestor Vampire: As Edwin Black is her father, her vampire blood makes her stronger than most full vampires.
Superhuman Strength, Endurance and Speed: Is able to decapitate someone with just her hand.
Blood Magic: Like Kurenai potentially could be powered up by blood.
Regeneration: Is able to heal from minor wounds.
Sun Immunity: Like her father and sister, immune to the sun.
Duplication Magic: Creates magical clones
Taimanin Potential: Could gain Taima Particle control or Ninja Art but given her full Demonization maybe that is at this point impossible.

Trivia
Felicia has a high kill count, multiple siblings, her own mother Shinganji Kaede, Tendo Kazuma, and at least putting Amamiya Shisui, into a coma.
Has not killed her mother in RPGX.
It is stated by Edwin Black, that Felicia is the little sister and the second child of Shinganji Kaede. Given that, Kaede basically acted as a "breeder", it can be assumed that Felicia is around 9 month younger than Kurenai.
The total number of other siblings killed by Felicia is unknown.
Like other half-demons or even her sister, theoretically, she could be able to learn Taimanin skills. However, was never shown to use any.
Outside Felicia and Shinganji Kurenai, which are direct siblings. Noah Brown might be considered a half sibling of sorts, as she was created from Edwin Black's genes.
Action Taimanin, never does really spell out the true nature of the events with her mother. It is unclear if in that more "happy ending"-like world she had nothing to do with the death of her mother or if "experiment" means she is fully disconnected to Kurenai. RPGX also currently makes the entire family situation including her mother Shinganji Kaede into a mystery on purpose.
Felicia was born after Kurenai.
A repeating theme of any "what if" event is Felicia killing those which capture her.
Felicia fate in normal canon is kept vague. For it speaks that the attack of Kurenai was one, that was explicitly mentioned to kill immortal bodies by attacking their life line. Felicia is visibly surprised and cut deeply, almost into two. Felicia does not move or breath afterward. Edwin Black when taking her body refuses to fight Kurenai, in order not to "lose two daughters in one day". However, he also protects Felicia's body and states that the fight is over and Felica would be unable to return to her normal form. Followed by stating immediate action needed to be taken. As such it was left vague if she survived.
Felicia is technically related to the Shinganji clan and would be part of the Fuuma clan as a result. Her true name reflects it as it is "Shinganji Fumika".
The TABA version of Felicia might be a clone given that the Monster House is mentioned for their cloning technology of Dragon Gate or she might have been healed by Fürst. It cannot be confirmed either way.
In AT, Felicia has claimed that her shadow scythe is stored somewhere in the demon realm, and that she is physically retrieving it through her magic circle when it is "summoned". Some taimanin she has shared this with have doubts, but no one has been able to verify whether or not she's telling the truth.
Felicia has stopped aging physically at some point, she is a good example of the "Really 700 Years Old Vampire"-Trope together with Kurenai in TABA. Though, she is not that old and still younger than Shinganji Kurenai.
It is hinted that she is attracted to her sister Kurenai but annoyed by their different chest sizes.
She is diametrically opposed to Kurenai: While Kurenai was parented by her Taimanin grandfather, Felicia was (more or less) parented by her vampire father. While Kurenai is mature but has some minor childish attributes, Felicia looks childish and acts childish but hides an insane, experienced adult. While Kurenai is a proud Taimanin and rejected her demon side, Felicia is a proud demon and rejects her human side.
In the games Action Taimanin, Felicia is probably in love with Kotaro Fuuma.
Like Saya, she is a pink haired, insane, demon girl that had Taimanin ties.
It is suggested that Felicia already exists in the ZERO universe, by hints within RPGX. She already resembles her unaging self in that cameo.
While games, like Action Taimanin are vague about her origin and call her an experiment of Edwin Black, both canon and other games are more explicit calling her his daughter, and birthed from Kurenai's mother and Black.
Multiple voicelines of her appear in data of Taimanin GOGO but are unused.
